summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional only for bounded internal, reversible work that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access but not commercial/public display, storage, derivatives, caching, alerts, affiliate use, or advertising rights; public terms restrict those uses. Human counsel is required for Woot rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. No go-live decision is supported.

All four launch-readiness tasks remain open. Existing API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms evidence is insufficient to close any task. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level source rights, deployed data flow and retention, log/vendor/incident/request inventory, consent and GA4 configuration, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Woot API deal and price-history data: blocked; obtain written rights and field-level use limits, then obtain human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results: evidence_needed; produce the deployed/repository data-flow and retention table, including identifiers, Slack delivery, deletion, correction, access, consent, and unsubscribe behavior. GA4 analytics: evidence_needed; capture deployed consent/withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing and retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment without enabling new tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data: evidence_needed; produce the log-field, retention/access, vendor, incident, subpoena, and data-subject-request inventory, then route unresolved gaps to human counsel.

Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deploy, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach dated ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker evidence.

Compliance is a technical baseline, not certification: 36 sites pass, 17 fail, and 6 are unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics quality is yellow because source permissions or collector errors remain; do not treat unavailable data as zero. Revenue evidence is limited to 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate Amazon commission for 2026-09-21, not site-attributable. Margin, ROI, forecasts, and causal lift remain unknown. Ordinary growth need not be blocked solely by incomplete telemetry, but launch and monetization expansion remain gated where rights, disclosures, consent, claims, provenance, or platform-policy evidence is incomplete.
